lines.para: Born in 1916 in Michigan to Finnish parents. Taken to the Soviet Union at sixteen by a communist stepfather. Lumberjack in Karelia, Red Army soldier, English teacher. In 1958, sent back to the United States as an “illegal” spy. American-born, Soviet-trained: which of the two countries was he betraying?
It is said that he warned Moscow in the very first message the FBI dictated to him. That he switched sides a third time. Only he ever told it.
